crossRefs.note: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.
Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell…
without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

translations.web: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
translations.bsb: Then Joseph threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept as they embraced.
translations.kjv: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
translations.asv: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
